skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence and content of development management, including its process, principles, and conditions.
Analyze the role of communities in development management and methods to engage them.
Understand the role of government in development management and its functions.
Analyze the role of the private sector in development management and methods to engage them.
Apply critical thinking to analyze real-world development management issues.
Develop self-learning and research skills, and ethical awareness.
Demonstrate teamwork skills and contribute effectively to group discussions.
